title.narrative: Women-Centered Non-communicable diseases Care: Integrating Prevention, Treatment
Women-Centered Non-communicable diseases Care: Integrating Prevention, Treatment

description.narrative:
Project Objective The overall objective of the project is to: Strengthen women-centered NCD care across the West Bank that is community-based and integrates prevention, early detection, diagnosis, and management services. The project will prioritise addressing breast cancer, cardiovascular diseases, and diabetes, prioritising womens access to services, mental health provision, and the availability of essential medications.
Outcome 1: Enhanced early detection and screening of breast cancer and other non-communicable diseases (NCDs), prioritizing access and outcomes for underserved women
Outcome 2: Expanded access to essential NCD medications through Primary Health Care (PHC) facilities in the West Bank.
Outcome 3: Enhanced capacity of healthcare providers to deliver gender-responsive care for NCDs (CVD, diabetes, cancer), integrating mental health, physiotherapy, and nutrition services to address the unique health needs of women.
Outcome 4: Enhanced community awareness, early health-seeking behavior including education on early detection and screening, and self-management practices for NCDs, with a focus on women and families.
Outcome 5: Strengthened policy environment and national protocols for gender-sensitive NCD management, aligned with international best practices

Projektets övergripande mål är att: Stärka den kvinnocentrerade vården av icke-smittsamma sjukdomar i hela Västbanken, som är samhällsbaserad och integrerar förebyggande åtgärder, tidig upptäckt, diagnos och behandling. Projektet kommer att prioritera bröstcancer, hjärt-kärlsjukdomar och diabetes, med fokus på kvinnors tillgång till vård, psykisk hälsa och tillgång till nödvändiga läkemedel.
